name: Saola
desc: A rare ox-like animal confined to the Annamite Range, listed in the park as possibly present. It feeds on leaves, including spleenwort, pulled into the mouth with a long tongue.
about: The saola, also called the spindlehorn, Asian unicorn, or infrequently, Vũ Quang bovid, is a forest-dwelling bovid native to the Annamite Range in Vietnam and Laos.
